name: Keldran
summary: North of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, Keldran works to clear a path toward peace with the Alliance. He directs covert strikes against demonic remnants, hoping to show that the modern Horde has forsaken the Burning Legion.

sections.title: A Diplomatic Crusade
sections.body: Keldran works from Orgrimmar’s red rock terraces while Thrall governs from the Valley of Wisdom. The Alliance still sees all orcs as bloodthirsty puppets of demonic masters, a reputation forged during the first wars. Keldran believes Thrall is weary of endless conflict, but peace talks cannot begin while demon-worshiping cults endure in Kalimdor. Without the Warchief’s formal sanction, he takes the initiative himself. He directs trusted agents toward distant threats, hoping to erase the demonic stain and clear the way for diplomacy.

sections.title: The War in Desolace
sections.body: In Desolace, Keldran has sent Takata Steelblade and Maurin Bonesplitter to lead operations against demonic infestations. Their chief target is the Burning Blade cult. Keldran hopes to eradicate these practitioners and bring proof back to Orgrimmar, showing the Alliance that the new Horde stands against the Legion alongside humans and night elves.

faq.answer: Keldran works north of the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar, organizing efforts against demonic influence to open a path toward diplomacy with the Alliance.

faq.q: Why does Keldran care about relations with the Alliance?
faq.answer: Keldran believes Thrall is growing weary of constant war with the Alliance. Peace talks cannot begin while the Alliance thinks the Horde remains allied with the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Is Keldran acting under Thrall's official orders?
faq.answer: No. Keldran acts without formal authorization from Warchief Thrall, seeking to clear the Horde’s name and prepare the way for peace.

faq.q: What is Keldran doing in Desolace?
faq.answer: Keldran sent Takata Steelblade and Maurin Bonesplitter to Desolace to fight demonic forces, with special emphasis on wiping out the Burning Blade cultists.

angles.text: Keldran represents a forward-thinking part of the Horde that sees the need to shed its demonic reputation to secure lasting peace on Kalimdor.
Keldran’s covert war against the Burning Blade shows how strongly the Horde’s leadership wants to distance itself from uncontrolled demonic corruption.
